section_summary.extract_value: This Methods section describes a single study (Study X) recruiting 246 participants (104 women, 142 men) from Amazon's Mechanical Turk, an online community-based platform. Participants ranged in age from 18 to 69 (M = 32.31), with 72.7% identifying as White. Data were collected via an online survey with compensation of $0.75.
